title: Relative clauses (1)
summary: Определительные придаточные: **who / which / that**, пропуск местоимения-дополнения, различие определяющих (без запятых) и поясняющих (с запятыми) придаточных.
ru:
## Что делает придаточное определительное
Придаточное определительное стоит сразу после существительного и отвечает на вопрос «какой?». В английском его вводят **who** (люди), **which** (вещи), **that** (и люди, и вещи, но только в определяющих придаточных). Главное различие — **определяющее (defining)** или **поясняющее (non-defining)**.
> The doctor **who treated me** was kind. — Врач, который меня лечил, был добр. (какой именно врач)
> Dr Lee, **who treated me**, was kind. — Доктор Ли, который меня лечил, был добр. (дополнительная информация)

## Определяющее придаточное: без запятых
Указывает, **о каком именно** предмете или человеке речь; без него предложение теряет смысл. **Запятых нет**, **that** допустим. После **all, everything, something, anything, nothing, the only, the first, the best** и других превосходных степеней принято именно **that**:
> Everything **that** she told us was true. — Всё, что она нам сказала, было правдой.
> It was the best meal **that** I've ever had. — Это был лучший обед в моей жизни.
> There's nothing **that** I can do. — Я ничего не могу сделать.
- ~~Everything what she said~~ → Everything **that** she said

## Когда местоимение можно опустить
Если местоимение — **дополнение** придаточного (то есть после него есть своё подлежащее), его можно (и в разговорной речи желательно) опустить:
> The laptop **(that / which)** I bought is already broken. — Ноутбук, который я купил, уже сломался.
> The candidate **(who / whom / that)** we interviewed first was the best.

Если местоимение — **подлежащее** придаточного (за ним сразу глагол), опускать **нельзя**:
- ~~The man lives next door is rude.~~ → The man **who** lives next door is rude.
- ~~I know a woman designs bridges.~~ → I know a woman **who** designs bridges.

## Поясняющее придаточное: с запятыми
Добавляет **дополнительную** информацию; без него смысл предложения сохраняется. Выделяется запятыми (в речи — паузами). **That** здесь **не употребляется**, и местоимение **опустить нельзя**:
> My brother, **who** lives in Toronto, is a pilot. — Мой брат, который живёт в Торонто, пилот. (брат один)
> The village, **which** is very old, stands on a hill.
- ~~My car, that I bought last year, is red.~~ → My car, **which** I bought last year, is red.

Запятые меняют смысл: *My sister who lives in Rome is a nurse* подразумевает, что сестёр несколько, а *My sister, who lives in Rome, is a nurse* — что сестра одна.

## Согласование и типичные ошибки
Глагол в придаточном согласуется с существительным, к которому относится местоимение: *She is one of the nurses who **work** nights* (nurses — мн. число), но *She is the only one of the nurses who **works** nights.*
- ~~The man who he lives next door~~ → The man who lives next door (местоимение не дублируем)
- ~~The book what I read~~ → The book **that** I read (**what** не заменяет who/which/that)
- ~~The film that I saw it~~ → The film **that** I saw
en:
## What a relative clause does
A relative clause comes straight after a noun and says which one or gives more information. It is introduced by **who** (people), **which** (things) or **that** (people and things, but only in defining clauses). The key distinction is **defining** vs **non-defining**.
> The doctor **who treated me** was kind. (which doctor)
> Dr Lee, **who treated me**, was kind. (extra information)

## Defining clauses: no commas
They identify **which** person or thing we mean; without them the sentence would be incomplete. There are **no commas**, and **that** is possible. After **all, everything, something, anything, nothing, the only, the first, the best** and other superlatives, **that** is the usual choice:
> Everything **that** she told us was true.
> It was the best meal **that** I've ever had.
> There's nothing **that** I can do.
- ~~Everything what she said~~ → Everything **that** she said

## When you can leave the pronoun out
If the pronoun is the **object** of the clause (another subject follows it), you can leave it out, and in speech usually do:
> The laptop **(that / which)** I bought is already broken.
> The candidate **(who / whom / that)** we interviewed first was the best.

If the pronoun is the **subject** of the clause (a verb follows it directly), you **cannot** leave it out:
- ~~The man lives next door is rude.~~ → The man **who** lives next door is rude.

## Non-defining clauses: commas
They add **extra** information; the sentence still makes sense without them. They are set off by commas (pauses in speech). **That** is **not used**, and the pronoun **cannot be dropped**:
> My brother, **who** lives in Toronto, is a pilot. (I have one brother)
> The village, **which** is very old, stands on a hill.
- ~~My car, that I bought last year, is red.~~ → My car, **which** I bought last year, is red.

Commas change meaning: *My sister who lives in Rome is a nurse* suggests I have more than one sister; *My sister, who lives in Rome, is a nurse* suggests I have one.

## Agreement and common mistakes
The verb in the clause agrees with the noun the pronoun refers to: *She is one of the nurses who **work** nights*, but *She is the only one of the nurses who **works** nights.*
- ~~The man who he lives next door~~ → The man who lives next door (don't repeat the subject)
- ~~The book what I read~~ → The book **that** I read
- ~~The film that I saw it~~ → The film **that** I saw
structure:
## Какое местоимение выбрать
| Тип | Люди | Вещи | Можно опустить? |
|---|---|---|---|
| Определяющее, подлежащее | **who / that** | **which / that** | нет |
| Определяющее, дополнение | **who / whom / that** | **which / that** | да |
| Поясняющее (запятые) | **who / whom** | **which** | нет, **that** нельзя |

## Формулы
> существительное + **who / which / that** + глагол… (подлежащее)
> существительное + (**that / which / who**) + подлежащее + глагол… (дополнение)
> существительное**,** + **who / which** + … **,** (поясняющее)
> all / everything / nothing / the only / superlative + **that**

## Запятые и смысл
| Без запятых | С запятыми |
|---|---|
| My sister **who lives in Rome** is a nurse. (есть и другие сёстры) | My sister**, who lives in Rome,** is a nurse. (сестра одна) |
| The tourists **who ignored the warning** were fined. (только некоторые) | The tourists**, who ignored the warning,** were fined. (все) |

exercises.title: who, which или that?
exercises.instruction: Вставьте **who**, **which**, **that** или **whom**. Если допустимо несколько вариантов, подойдёт любой из них.
exercises.example: The man ___ called is my uncle. → The man **who** called is my uncle.

items.text: The researcher {{who|that}} led the study has received a major prize.
This is the only app {{that|which}} works offline.
Everything {{that}} she said about the project was true.
The documents {{which|that}} were stolen contained client data.
Anyone {{who|that}} wants to join the trip must register by Friday.
The report, {{which}} was published last week, caused a huge controversy.
The candidate {{whom|who|that}} we interviewed first was the most impressive.
It was the best meal {{that}} I've ever had.

exercises.title: Согласование глагола
exercises.instruction: Поставьте глагол в скобках в правильную форму (present simple, если не указано иначе).

items.text: He is one of the few engineers who {{understand}} the whole system. (understand)
She is the only one of my friends who {{lives}} abroad. (live)
The people who {{live}} next door are very quiet. (live)
Let me know if there is anything that {{needs}} fixing. (need)
The students who {{were}} late missed the introduction. (be, past simple)
Is she the one who {{is|'s}} responsible for the budget? (be)

items.q: The woman ___ lives upstairs is a violinist.
items.why: Речь о человеке и местоимение — подлежащее придаточного → **who** (или **that**).

items.q: The film ___ we watched last night was dull.
items.why: Фильм — вещь: **that** (или **which**); **what** не вводит определительное придаточное.

items.q: He told me something ___ I couldn't believe.
The new manager, ___ is from Canada, starts on Monday.
The village, ___ is very old, stands on a hill.
items.why: Запятые → **which**; **that** не используется в поясняющих придаточных.

items.q: Everything ___ they offered was too expensive.
items.why: После **everything** нормой считается **that**; **what** не ставится после существительного, **who** — только о людях.

items.q: It's the most interesting article ___ I've read this year.
items.why: После превосходной степени — **that** (местоимение можно и опустить).

items.q: В каком предложении местоимение можно опустить?
options: The man who called me is a dentist.
The man who I called is a dentist.
The man who lives here is a dentist.
items.why: В 2-м варианте **who** — дополнение (после него есть подлежащее **I**); в остальных — подлежащее.

options: The book what I read was good.
The book that I read was good.
The book that I read it was good.
items.why: **What** не вводит определительное придаточное, а **it** дублирует дополнение.

options: The man who he lives next door is rude.
The man who lives next door is rude.
The man lives next door is rude.
items.why: Подлежащее придаточного нельзя ни дублировать, ни опускать.

options: My car, that I bought last year, is red.
My car, which I bought last year, is red.
My car, I bought last year, is red.
items.why: Поясняющее придаточное требует **which** и не допускает **that** или пропуска.

items.q: В каком предложении подразумевается, что у говорящего несколько сестёр?
options: My sister who lives in Rome is a nurse.
My sister, who lives in Rome, is a nurse.
My sister, that lives in Rome, is a nurse.
items.why: Определяющее придаточное без запятых уточняет, о какой из сестёр речь.

items.q: She is one of the nurses who ___ on night shifts.

exercises.title: Соедините предложения
exercises.instruction: Соедините два предложения в одно с помощью определительного придаточного.

items.prompt: I met a woman. She designs bridges.
answers: I met a woman who designs bridges.
I met a woman that designs bridges.

items.prompt: The laptop is on the table. I bought it last week.
answers: The laptop that I bought last week is on the table.
The laptop which I bought last week is on the table.
The laptop I bought last week is on the table.

items.prompt: The scientists have won a prize. They discovered the new species.
answers: The scientists who discovered the new species have won a prize.
The scientists that discovered the new species have won a prize.

items.prompt: Everything was true. She told me it.
answers: Everything that she told me was true.
Everything she told me was true.

items.prompt: It was the funniest play. I have ever seen it.
answers: It was the funniest play that I have ever seen.
It was the funniest play I have ever seen.
It was the funniest play that I've ever seen.
It was the funniest play I've ever seen.

items.prompt: I read a report. It criticised the plan.
answers: I read a report that criticised the plan.
I read a report which criticised the plan.
I read a report that criticized the plan.
I read a report which criticized the plan.

items.prompt: (Non-defining clause) Mount Elbrus is in Russia. It is the highest peak in Europe.
answers: Mount Elbrus, which is the highest peak in Europe, is in Russia.
Mount Elbrus, which is in Russia, is the highest peak in Europe.

items.prompt: (Non-defining clause) My brother lives in Toronto. He is a pilot.
answers: My brother, who lives in Toronto, is a pilot.
My brother, who is a pilot, lives in Toronto.

items.prompt: (Leave out the pronoun) The film that we saw was boring.
answers: The film we saw was boring.

items.prompt: (Leave out the pronoun) The decision which she made was brave.
answers: The decision she made was brave.

items.prompt: (Replace which with that) The only thing which matters is safety.
answers: The only thing that matters is safety.

items.prompt: (Use who) The tourists were stranded. They had booked through the agency.
answers: The tourists who had booked through the agency were stranded.
The tourists who booked through the agency were stranded.
The tourists, who had booked through the agency, were stranded.
The tourists, who booked through the agency, were stranded.

exercises.title: Напишите о себе
exercises.instruction: Ответьте полными предложениями, используя определительные придаточные.

items.prompt: Describe a person who has influenced you. Use who.
items.sample: My old physics teacher, who never gave up on me, taught me to love science.

items.prompt: Write about the best book that you have ever read.
items.sample: The best book I have ever read is a novel that changed the way I see history.

items.prompt: Describe a place where you feel relaxed, using which.
items.sample: My grandmother's garden, which is full of apple trees, is where I feel most relaxed.

items.prompt: Complete: I'm looking for a job that...
items.sample: I'm looking for a job that lets me work from home and travel a little.

items.prompt: Write about something you own and use every day. Use a clause without a pronoun.
items.sample: The phone I use every day is five years old, but it still works.

items.prompt: Write about a member of your family. Use a non-defining clause.
items.sample: My mother, who works as a nurse, always finds time to cook on Sundays.
